svg.text: Ramp editing V4 · short confirmation, details on demand
Proposal · 22 November 2026 · Same replacement behavior, less reading on the frequent path.
Default: change Step count → confirm
Optional: expand Details
Replace ramp with 6 steps?
Regenerates all colors, including Manual and Protected.
Removes steps absent from the new ramp, even if Protected.
Earlier draft edits will not return if you change the count back.
1 reference needs a new target · 2 other tokens affected

▸ Details
▾ Details
Surviving steps keep their identity, description and lock choices.
New steps start Generated and unprotected.
Old remapping choices are cleared; each required new choice
must be accepted before Apply.
A surviving valid seed position stays; otherwise Auto places it.
Discarding the whole draft restores the saved ramp.
The default opens with Details collapsed. Confirming never saves; Cancel keeps the current draft.
Counts are live: omit the impact line when nothing is affected. Never hide Manual / Protected replacement consequences.
